name: @avatark/living-rhythms-contracts
description: Renderer-neutral contracts for Sprint 13's living-rhythms domain: a world-shared DayPhaseSchedule, ResourceOpportunity, RoutineWindow/DailyRhythmDefinition, GroupRoutineIntent, PlaceOccupancy, a bounded PlaceRhythmProfile aggregate, and SocialInteractionOpportunity. No implementations, no renderer objects, zero franchise content, zero scripted timetables.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
